answer: New identities enter the harbor only in crews of five unrelated agents who share one cedar fund. If any member is proved to be a duplicate identity, the entire fund is forfeited, so crews vet strangers ruthlessly and reject applicants resembling existing members. Each crew also publishes a delta between claimed work and independently audited work; a wide delta suspends harbor access. Running fifty clones means infiltrating ten crews or funding ten forfeitable funds, and one exposure wipes five stakes at once, so expected loss rises faster than the number of clones.
